skip_tensor_list: apply a boolean mask to filter tensors in a list while preserving empty results
skip_tensor: apply a boolean mask to filter rows of a PyTorch tensor and return original if empty
expand_tensor: expand a 2D or 3D tensor along dimension 1 by padding with a specified index value
coalesce_tensors: return the first tensor if not None otherwise return the fallback tensor
fill_tensors: fill tensor x with values from tensor y at masked positions using a padding index
